title: SQMS Training Platform Dilution Refrigerator
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.FERMILAB - DOE CONTRACTOR
description_text: Fermilab is seeking to procure a dilution refrigerator for the SQMS project. Please see attached for Fermilab RFP# 380329swk and associated documentation. Please ensure you review the specification and RFP document fully, as they outline how to submit a complete proposal package. Important information for this RFP: Proposal Due Date: 5pm Central, May 19, 2026 Question Due Date: 5pm Central, May 11, 2026 This is a Best Value with Tradeoff source selection More information is included in Appendix A of the RFP document (page 3) A completed SARC and PUR-466 document are required for proposals over $10k Please reach out with any questions pertaining to this RFP.
